description: Quiz media upload, step 3 of 3. Requires idempotencyKey so a response-timeout retry replays one durable receipt. The server independently re-reads the stored object and verifies size, declared MIME type, container signature for the kind, and a server-computed SHA-256 before committing PENDING → READY; the optional expectedSha256 is a cross-check only. Invalid bytes invalidate the reservation (start a fresh prepare with a new key); a duplicate finalize returns the READY asset.

idempotencyKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key: 8-128 characters of letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash, or colon. Same key + same payload replays the stored receipt; same key + changed payload is a 409.

name: opentrain_lms_finalize_assessment_asset_upload
